mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration and economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above 3-month MAs fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy), a decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average signals supply shocks and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes, INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% for three consecutive months signals monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive deviation of consumer spending (RSAFS) from its 10-year moving average consistently signals strong aggregate demand, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS deviation from 10-year moving average fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), a sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average signals economic strength and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), PAYEMS growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high economic activity (GDPC1 > 18000 billion), a decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average signals supply disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high economic activity periods (GDPC1 > 18000 billion), INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
